mechanism: Methimazole can cause agranulocytosis and bone marrow suppression, which increases infection risk and reduces the safety margin of gentamicin use; gentamicin is nephrotoxic and methimazole may indirectly affect renal function through systemic effects.
action: Monitor CBC regularly during concurrent use; ensure adequate renal function assessment before gentamicin therapy; consider alternative antibiotics if possible and assess risk-benefit for continued methimazole therapy.
